definitions.hot: Both authority sessions resident; alternate A/B. Baseline actual selectSession includes required selection persistence; new pure viewSessionPage has no writes.
definitions.cold: New JS store and object-store instances; OS filesystem cache warm. Baseline selects cold target authority and persists; new projection decodes only final 30 display bodies.
definitions.sharedBackend: Both variants use current GlobalSessionStorage/object storage. Only ChatSessionStore and the select/view path vary; this is not a full old-extension release benchmark.
definitions.scope: Host read/publication preparation only. No actual Webview paint, cursor, durable input or Worker start measurements.

memoryScope: End-of-run sample and lifetime peak of the same benchmark process, including baseline/current fixtures; not separate runtime or concurrent Worker peaks.
limitations: No native VS Code/Webview paint measurement.
No true cold OS disk cache.
Memory includes baseline/current fixtures in one process, not isolated Worker peak.
No Provider usage or paid cache/fee measurement.
